Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 8 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Shear Line
Issued at: 2:00 PM, 25 November 2025(Tuesday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Quezon, Rizal, Laguna, Bulacan, Metro Manila and Batangas(Alitagtag, Balete, Batangas City, Bauan, Tanauan, Cuenca, Ibaan, Lipa, Lobo, Mabini, Malvar, Mataasnakahoy, Padre Garcia, Rosario, San Jose, San Juan, San Luis, San Nicolas, San Pascual, Santa Teresita, Santo Tomas, Taal, Talisay, Taysan, Tingloy).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Nueva Ecija, Tarlac, Pampanga, Zambales, Bataan, Cavite and Batangas(Agoncillo, Balayan, Calaca, Calatagan, Laurel, Lemery, Lian, Nasugbu, Tuy) which may persist within 3 hours.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 2:00 PM today.

For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.

A lot of people don’t realize how hard it is for governments and large companies to use blockchain at scale. 

Most networks work fine when traffic is low, but once you push real workloads, everything slows down or becomes too expensive. 
That’s why Venom has been getting attention lately. It’s one of the few networks designed from the ground up for the kind of pressure public institutions and major enterprises deal with every day.

@VenomFoundation focuses on solving the scaling issue in a practical way. 
Fees stay low, the network keeps up with demand, and the system adjusts itself through dynamic sharding so performance doesn’t dip when usage spikes.
It’s built for long-term growth, which is why the target of 500,000 daily transactions doesn’t feel unrealistic.

What really shows the direction Venom is heading are the projects already in motion.
The Philippines is using Venom as part of its national digitalization plans.
In the UAE, Venom is involved in building a transparent carbon credit system.
And talks are ongoing in China with a major fintech company that wants blockchain that actually works at scale.

If you’ve been thinking about getting involved, the BingX Spot Blast event is still open, but only for a short time. There are 48 hours left to join the $15,000 prize pool with Venom and @BingXOfficial .

It’s a good moment to jump in before the window closes. 
https://t.co/sdymdxLzw5
